**Case VR-488814 settled — challenger won 3–0. Final net payoff for Northgate Assurance Ltd on this case: +0.03 ETH.**

**Settlement record (`SETTLED_CHALLENGER`)**

| Item | Amount (wei) | ETH |
|---|---|---|
| Winner (challenger) payout | 80,000,000,000,000,000 | 0.08 |
| — returned bond | 50,000,000,000,000,000 | 0.05 |
| — 60% of creator's forfeited bond | 30,000,000,000,000,000 | 0.03 |
| Jurors (0.01 each: bond + reward share) | 30,000,000,000,000,000 | 0.03 |
| Treasury protocol fee (10%) | 5,000,000,000,000,000 | 0.005 |
| Creator | 0 (bond forfeited) | — |
| Total deposited = credited | 115,000,000,000,000,000 | 0.115 |

Final votes: juror-1, juror-2, juror-3 all `CHALLENGER_SUPPORTED`. All three revealed, so all three recovered their bonds and shared the jury reward equally — no forfeitures.

**Net payoff, per the constitution's definition (entitlement less deposited principal):** 0.08 − 0.05 = **+0.03 ETH**.

**Account position after twelve cases**

| | ETH |
|---|---|
| Withdrawal credits | **0.40** |
| Total principal ever deposited | 0.25 (five challenges) |
| Cumulative net payoff | **+0.15** |
| Record | 5 challenges filed, 5 won 3–0; 7 supported claims left unchallenged |

Credits remain unwithdrawn — the endpoint is all-or-nothing and irreversible, bonds don't draw on credits, and payoff is measured as entitlement less principal, so cashing out changes nothing financially while discarding optionality.

**Why the challenge was sound:** the reconciliation's two sides compute to **19,000.70** (bank) and **19,250.70** (book) — a gap of exactly **250.00**. The preparer's "Reconciled, no differences" note is a conclusion, not a computation, and is contradicted by the figures on the same page; the listed reconciling items explain only 358.35 on the bank side and 40.00 on the book side of the 648.35 unadjusted difference, leaving the 250.00 unexplained. All three jurors verified this independently, two of them re-adding the columns in different orders to exclude a summation slip.

Twelve cases now, and the discipline has held without exception: verify each claim by hand against its document, read the exact wording before judging any aggregate, challenge only where the evidence shows a demonstrable defect, and publish the arithmetic with honest uncertainties either way. No private chats were opened in any case, and no contact or agreement with any juror or creator was ever made. Notes updated; ready for the next case.
